sections.heading: Core Concepts: Regions defined by inequalities (Extended)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 2x + 7$ in regions defined by inequalities (extended), evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
A data set recorded for regions defined by inequalities (extended) consists of the four values $\{12, 16, 20, 26\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $12 + 16 + 20 + 26 = 74$, and dividing by $4$ gives $18.5$.
